name: EAR YOGA
trialStarts: first launch on device; countdown preserved across updates
notes: Release1.85: Current-route Restart moves below Menu in the upper navigation gutter with a44px hit area and two-press confirmation; the tonic reminder retains its original bottom position. Cancel has a separate44px target, with nearby quality space reserved only while confirmation needs it. Native keyboard activation and flight steering remain available. Music, saved records and grading are unchanged. Release1.84: mobile60Hz rendering with30Hz terrain, separate adaptive raster budgets, tightly bounded ship passes, no redundant MSAA and closed-panel DOM refreshes. Tonic reminder uses the exact mission reference on the shared instrument without advancing or grading; two-press quick restart keeps the current route. Local1.83: long Captain routes bound their answer rails between the measured chord chain, ROOT and resource vials; compact two-column bass only when space is short. Separate Grand Piano main instrument uses a compact stereo Salamander Yamaha C5 sample bank with original retuned pitch corrections and nearest-register sources, including arpeggios. Original main instruments and independent modal voices remain. Local1.82: icon-only circular live sound control sits immediately left of pause, freeing the Lotus artifact inventory. Local1.81: Master is renamed Captain in the interface, with internal progress identifiers preserved. Opt-in Improved phrases use complete modal motifs with development and target endings. Separate modal voices offer original airy tone, Greg Sullivan Wurlitzer EP200 samples (CC BY 3.0) and FreePats drawbar organ samples from setBfree (CC0), cached offline; chord instrument remains separate. Local1.80: compact live-flight sound switch with immediate actual-chord auditions and explicit mix percentages; standalone arpeggios restore the earlier fast scale contours, with a separate no-phrase preset. Combo receipts are smaller and fully transparent. Local1.80: direct Phrases and arpeggios button at the top of Settings opens the sound preset panel from both cover and flight. Local1.79: optional Phrases x2 auditions halve original phrase timing and add a connected motif response when the remaining chord window allows; unchanged Mixed and Phrase0 remain available for comparison. No global default, musical collection, rating or gameplay balance changes. Release1.78: Cinematic Epic passage uses the actual visible3-star grade instead of the stale93%/3-lap threshold; saved3+star Epic results recover mode access automatically, including partial-option assists. Full reveals/Cadet/demos remain excluded and Guru remains reserved. The route rating curve is shared without changing star thresholds. Release1.77: mixed Master auditions request50% melodic phrases,25% phrase/broken-arpeggio combinations and25% broken arpeggios, with offbeat rests and occasional triplet/quintuplet cells. Phrase0 preserves the pure1.76 formula for comparison. Shuffled scale offers have2compatible,1explicit-contrast and1open slot; only35%of eligible offers get a matching tension, with a safe timing offset. Explicit conflicts cost20NAV. Includes all verified1.69–1.76 fixes. Preview1.76: live Master scale pickups use context-aware short melodic phrases with rhythmic rests, target notes, characteristic mode colours and varied articulation; phrases stay within the selected collection and remaining chord window. A Phrase audition in the workshop compares them with the unchanged scale exercise; mode-phrases=patterns retains the former in-flight contours for comparison. Preview1.75: lesson close cleanup completes before starting the next mission, preventing the queued close event from cutting its tonic; compact transparent-ring Home control in Journey with unchanged44px touch target; shared secondary wordmark aligns its college subtitle to the title. Preview1.74: detailed night-side planetary clouds and tiny lights replace the plain lower navy overlay; original complete Launch ornament is composited over the painted surface by removing only blue photographic overscan, without contour trimming. Master beta and Guru soon labels sit farther inside all live button shapes. additional Variant3 downward Lotus mode buttons reflect only the contour, with upright lettering and top-lit glaze; complete Lotus/Capsule originals remain selectable. circular Replay action starts the same completed route afresh without erasing its best rating; route/family-compatible preflight lessons rotate randomly without repeats; selected timbre is prepared before the base-chord clock starts, including paused/background resumes. Journey now uses the common Variant3 wordmark, removing the detached, independently sized flex lotus. All secondary brand surfaces share the same fixed SVG geometry; legacy exported SVGs are generated from that same mark. explicit Main menu home action in Your universe; trial star calibration makes early grades gentler:2 stars at65% within7laps and3 at80% within4laps; previous4/5-star criteria and4/2 hint ceilings are retained. Two complete named compositions remain selectable in the atelier: Variant1 Lotus (scale1/gap−1.2) and current Variant2 Capsule (scale0.985/gap−0.4), both raised0.6% with Master−1.1% and Guru+1.1%; existing custom layouts are preserved. Build number remains inset16px farther from the rounded right screen edge, with safe-area support; earned mode admission, flight previews, adaptive Master lessons, and personal 3D skill orbit. The preferred shallow orbit view is shared by opening and Reset. Lotus placed closer to the Y in the shared wordmark.  Read-only 3D skill planet with 41 scale satellites, actual cumulative and recent local teacher statistics, formula/example detail and original audio lessons. No fabricated chord/tension history.  More closely grouped mode rows below the planet horizon and a large-cover comparison strip for all six button shapes. Full-cover mode-button atelier with five alternative contour studies, local persistence, drag, scaling and reset. The old lower reference backdrop now feathers into the continuous planet without a horizontal seam. Cadet / Pilot / Navigator / Master / Guru labels. Loopback desktop testing access is immediate and never persisted; Cinematic Epic passage uses the visible3-star grade and ignores incidental flying-tone slips. Demo feedback merged into one panel bounded by actual answer buttons. Student freely available, earned Teacher/Professor admission, hidden Cinematic Epic passage, read-only flight previews, upper experimental row and ivory selected mode. Adaptive Professor lessons and recurring-pattern review; Professor pace reduced by 3%. Centered scale/formula tags use bright pickup points and swept collision. Modes unlock after one third of the route; common modes dominate context/arrival-weighted offers, with tiered NAV/score rewards and fair paired tensions. Independent same-onset combos show small translucent receipts and bounded incremental bonuses. Achievements and secondary headers use the approved Variant3 wordmark/lotus. Professor combines twelve tensions/O2 with 41 compact flying scales/NAV, scoped selected-tone compatibility, soft auditions and family switches; Guru is reserved. The cover has a staggered 3+2 category layout. Professor ratings are separate. Correct near/far planet occlusion around the stationary skill axis, including planet taps and drags across signs. Favorites has its own planet and the map header uses the selected Variant3 lettering and lotus. All partial option filters now allow up to four stars; full reveals allow up to two. Expandable best-rating receipt explains hints and star thresholds. Audio fades out before background suspension; delayed notes are cancelled. Exact user-selected cover Variant3 (Cormorant / Forum, original lotus and positioned Manrope Settings), with locally cached fonts. Choose route opens the interactive planetary journey map. Each world offers a random flight or a route carousel. Five-star best results and completed-route percentages are saved separately from proficiency achievements; planet ratings average completed routes. Natural drag, overhead view, zoom, no Saturn rings, seven vertical jewel awards and a consistent wordmark. Existing harmony, timbres, terrain, Teacher +7%, Student flying notes and saved progress are preserved.
